def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    portfolio_returns = [0.02, 0.03, 0.01, -0.01, 0.02, 0.01,
                         0.03, 0.02, 0.01, 0.02, 0.01, 0.04]
    market_returns = [0.01, 0.02, 0.02, -0.02, 0.03, 0.02,
                      0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    portfolio_mean = sum(portfolio_returns) / len(portfolio_returns)
    market_mean = sum(market_returns) / len(market_returns)

    covariance = sum(
        (portfolio_return - portfolio_mean) * (market_return - market_mean)
        for portfolio_return, market_return in zip(portfolio_returns, market_returns)
    )

    market_variance = sum(
        (market_return - market_mean) ** 2
        for market_return in market_returns
    )

    beta = covariance / market_variance

    # Return answer rounded to two decimal places
    return round(beta, 2)
